svg.title: Customized shuttle transit
svg.desc: Published in Information in 2021. Time-window-aware shuttle routing with optional passenger transfers and ALNS–Tabu Search. Figure 1 is reproduced with its original spatial arrangement: every vehicle, passenger group, pickup and destination symbol, transfer arrow, and vehicle route retains the source position and direction. Colours and serif lettering are unified with the profile; four long explanatory passages are shortened in place.

svg.title: Customized shuttle transit: original operational diagram
svg.desc: Faithful coordinate-preserving reproduction of Figure 1 in Information 12(10), 429 (2021), DOI 10.3390/info12100429. All vehicles, passenger groups, pickup circles, destination squares, transfer arrows and curved vehicle routes retain the original position, orientation and count. Source raster tiles are traced as vector runs, with a fixed colour mapping. Only the four explanatory paragraphs are shortened in place.
